title: Kissinger studied under Thomas Schelling, who later tried an intervention

tellings.quote: he actually studied at at Harvard under Tom shelling

plain: Henry Kissinger studied at Harvard under a man named Thomas Schelling, who, as the story goes, later tried to stage an intervention with him once Kissinger was at the White House. Michels mentions it himself, in passing, in an episode with the psychic spy Joe McMoneagle, and says nothing more about what the intervention was.
